description: Everything about one product by UIN: each fact read from its documents (waiting periods, limits, co-pay, exclusions, claims, renewal rights...) with the verbatim quote, the clause and page it came from, its check status, and the law behind it; plus its documents, versions, where to buy and where to claim. status "not-stated" means the documents do not say: never fill it from memory.
name: get_policy
